items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Jaguars, along with WR Tank Dell (knee) and S Jalen Pitre.
items.why: Groin injury; team decision not to travel for London game.
items.implication: Full backfield to Woody Marks or other backups; Marks previously took 98% snaps when Montgomery exited.
items.opportunity: Clear lead role and touches for remaining Texans RBs; high snap share expected.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; out indefinitely until situation resolved, Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in small superficial blood clot originally found pre-London game; health priority.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles pass game and Hurts rushing upside gone short-term; monitor treatment course for multi-week absence risk.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Eagles pass-catchers and McKee streaming; reverse any prior Hurts start assumptions.

items.text: Patriots announced TreVeyon Henderson multi-week out with high ankle sprain; in prior inactive, Rhamondre Stevenson played 85% snaps and 23 touches, averaging 16.3 PPG on >15 touches since 2024.
items.implication: Stevenson clear workhorse RB1/2 with massive volume boost.
items.opportunity: Stevenson snap share and touches spike significantly; handcuff unnecessary short-term.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore DNP second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Questionable availability; Bills WR depth tested.
items.opportunity: Targets shift to other Bills receivers if limited/out.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.implication: Availability in doubt for Week 6; monitor for GTD or OUT.
items.opportunity: Increased work for other Cardinals RBs if inactive.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) DNP for second straight day/practice; WR DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice.
items.why: Ongoing hamstring; Smith hamstring/toe improved to limited.
items.implication: Barkley game-time or risk OUT; Eagles thin at RB with other injuries; Smith closer to playing.
items.opportunity: If Barkley OUT, backup RB volume spikes; Smith limited still positive for availability.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice DNP again Thursday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Risky or likely limited/OUT for Week 6; impacts Chiefs WR target distribution.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Xavier Worthy and other KC receivers if Rice sidelined.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially DNP again on Thursday practice.
items.implication: Status uncertain for Week 6; monitor Friday report closely for return or further absence.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Ravens backup QB and adjusted pass game; Ja'Kobi Lane return buzz in same offense.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs Falcons.
items.why: Full practice participation consecutive days after hamstring absence.
items.implication: Expected to start; positive for Bears skill players.
items.opportunity: Full QB snaps and normal offense volume restored.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI) for elite recent usage and leaky run D; loves Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) for volume with Henderson multi-week out (85% snaps/23 touches prior); loves Javonte Williams for goal-line role.
items.why: Volume, usage trends, matchups vs poor run defenses; Henderson high-ankle multi-week confirmed.
items.implication: Strong start signals; Stevenson clear lead with Henderson out.
items.opportunity: Stevenson elevated snap/touch share; Kyren/Javonte secure roles.

items.text: Berry loves Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH) and George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH) vs Commanders soft pass D; loves Drake London (WR6 vs CHI); loves Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH). Hates Jaylen Waddle, Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts, JK Dobbins, Bo Nix, Justin Herbert.
items.why: Matchup-driven (WSH buffet for pass catchers); usage bankable for London; high-scoring environments for QBs. Hates on tough matchups/QB issues/role.
items.implication: Start Evans/London/Kittle/Purdy confidently; fade the hates.
items.opportunity: Elevated target/red-zone for loved pass-catchers vs weak Ds.

items.text: With Breece Hall week-to-week and not practicing, RB snaps in two full games since injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Allen dominating post-Hall absence.
items.why: Snap data shows Allen near-monopoly on RB work.
items.implication: Allen is the clear lead back and fantasy starter while Hall out; Hall remains week-to-week.
items.opportunity: Allen high snap/route/carry share; minimal committee.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return in TNF due to shoulder, then returned to the game.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return.
items.implication: Played through; monitor for lingering effects post-TNF but active event resolves short-term uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Maintained role; no immediate beneficiary shift.

items.text: Levitan notes Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb etc.); Saquon turns 30 in Feb—if contender with RB need, at least call. Separately ETR discusses MHJ trade to HOU with Bourne target upside; Warren monster day as Dowdle return looms.
items.why: Age/precedent for potential trade value; MHJ departure opens targets for Bourne; Warren usage strong.
items.implication: Longer-term Saquon trade speculation; short-term Cardinals/HOU WR reshuffle and Steelers RB committee watch.
items.opportunity: Bourne routes/targets up post-MHJ; Warren elevated pending Dowdle.
